summary: The revision closes the six gaps reported by Keeper attempt 6 and its PowerShell 7 L0 gate is reproducible, but a fresh Agent still cannot implement TASK-008 without inventing persistence, indexing, readiness, provenance, deep-dive lifecycle, and Prisma toolchain decisions.

gaps.gap: The ID-free elicitation-unit proposal cannot be losslessly or stably committed. `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md:280-284` gives each `ElicitationUnitProposal` `target_dimensions`, but committed `ElicitationUnit` at :271-278 has no such field and no stable order/index. `QuestionProposal.elicitation_unit_index` at :333-344 is also used for `continue_wave`, while `.loom/design/state-and-persistence-protocol.md:142` requires that index to resolve to a committed pending unit after refresh. A relational read has no canonical array order from which to resolve it.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: TASK-008 must define the Zod and Prisma shapes before rewiring routes. The Agent must choose whether to discard per-unit dimensions, add undeclared persisted fields/order, sort by an implementation heuristic, or change continue-wave proposals to reference trusted committed IDs; those choices alter context stability, question-to-unit integrity, and migration schema.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Define one lossless committed unit shape and deterministic mapping for both opening and later microbatches. Either persist `target_dimensions` plus an immutable `order_in_wave` and specify context serialization, or use proposal-local indexes only at open and exact trusted unit IDs for continue. Add refresh/reload and reordered-database-read tests proving the same question resolves to the same unit.

gaps.gap: Route readiness defines status-combination truth but not an executable derivation of each `GateStatus` from committed facts. `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md:492-539` exhaustively maps supplied statuses to booleans, yet only partially defines when statuses become `met`. `.loom/design/adaptive-interview-system.md:198-209` additionally requires a material constraint, at least two distinct scene sources and at least two calibrations (or skip), without mapping those facts to the eight canonical gates or explaining whether one explicit skip satisfies the stated two-calibration rule.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: TASK-008 owns the readiness contract and the `PARALLEL_LIVES_COMMITTED` guard. A fresh Agent can test the boolean formula only by injecting already-decided statuses; it cannot compute those statuses from persisted sources, radar, calibrations and accepted intents without inventing thresholds and ownership.
gaps.evidence_to_close: For every readiness field, define a pure host derivation from named committed records and exact SourceRefs, reconcile the two-scene/two-calibration/material-constraint criteria with the canonical gate list, and add fixtures that build facts and assert the derived statuses before asserting formal/provisional booleans.

gaps.gap: Model edits to existing claims have no revision-safe generation provenance rule. `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md:145-154` gives `Claim` one `generation_provenance_id` and no artifact revision/history, while `MemoryOperationProposal.update_claim` at :403-410 can change its generated text/evidence. The provenance rules at :29-50 and :773 require generated records to remain attributable, but do not say whether an update retains the old provenance, overwrites it with the new call, or creates a new claim version.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: TASK-008 must implement atomic memory operations, stale propagation and immutable generation provenance. Retaining the FK misattributes new content to an old call; replacing it loses origin; mutating in place prevents replay/audit. Each option requires a different schema and propagation algorithm.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Define immutable artifact revision/history semantics for model-updated claims (or remove model `update_claim` in favor of supersede-and-create), including provenance ownership, dependency edges, stale behavior and replay. Add a two-call test showing both the original and updated content are attributed reproducibly.

gaps.gap: The deep-dive proposal has two incompatible model-facing shapes and no single carry-through path. Canonical `InterviewerProposal` in `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md:347-378` uses `mode=propose_deep_dive` with mission, 5-10 units, 1-3 questions and `deep_dive_reason`; `.loom/design/adaptive-interview-system.md:165-178` separately defines `DeepDiveProposal` with `eligible_reason`, `source_refs`, `route_decision_affected` and `proposed_mission`, but no opening questions. The transition flow commits only `{kind, deep_dive_reason}` in `NEXT_WAVE_COMMITTED` (`state-and-persistence-protocol.md:151,207`) before a later `WAVE_MISSION_COMMITTED`, so it does not say whether the proposed mission is discarded, reused, or regenerated.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: TASK-008 must implement deep dives 0-2 and proposal/commit separation. The Agent must invent whether there are one or two model calls/schemas, which proposal owns the mission, and how provenance/idempotency applies across `DEEP_DIVE_PROPOSED`, `NEXT_WAVE_COMMITTED` and wave open.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Choose one explicit deep-dive lifecycle with one canonical schema per call, state what survives `NEXT_WAVE_COMMITTED`, and align adaptive-interview-system, Interviewer prompt, EventPayloadMap and tests for accepted, rejected, retried and refreshed deep-dive proposals.

gaps.gap: TASK-008's documented Prisma evidence commands are not executable from a frozen install. `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` contain `@prisma/client@6.6.0` but no `prisma` CLI. After `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, pnpm reports the Prisma client build script was ignored; `pnpm exec prisma validate` fails with `prisma is not recognized`, and `pnpm typecheck`/`pnpm build` fail because `PrismaClient`/`Prisma` were not generated. TASK-008 names `pnpm exec prisma ...` as exact evidence but only explicitly directs adding XState v5, Vitest and fast-check.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: A fresh Agent cannot establish a passing donor baseline or run the required validate/migrate commands without deciding to add an undeclared matching Prisma CLI dependency and a pnpm-10-safe client-generation/build-script policy. That dependency and install policy affect the lockfile, CI and every required evidence command.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Declare the exact Prisma CLI version and deterministic fresh-install/client-generation policy (including pnpm build-script handling), then demonstrate from no `node_modules` that `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm exec prisma validate`, the documented migrate commands, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm build` reach the expected baseline.

evidence: `rtk loom context --keeper` reported Keeper attempt 7, frozen digest d8fc839ddb808990c0d0c2bbc3d11b42bd3ca65bec7578915ca95a90a6e2f38f, 27 facts, zero assumptions/questions, 11 design documents, 10 capability dossiers and 13 tasks.

`rtk loom check` returned healthy; task status was 13 total / 7 open / 6 done, and `rtk loom task get TASK-008` supplied the exact donor reads, first inventory action, dependencies, touches and evidence commands.

Every TASK-008 declared read exists; a SHA-256/size inventory covered all design/capability/prompt/package/Prisma/route/helper/test files, and donor inspection confirmed SQLite/Prisma tables, guest 24-hour ownership, consent/upload routes, fixed Wave 1, MAX_WAVES=4/MAX_QUESTIONS=19, working-memory helpers and current regression tests.

The attempt-6 closures are present on disk: ID-free mission/question/option proposals with 5-10 units, required calibration SourceVersion, complete GenerationProvenance fields, exited-trial reflection guard/test, and a PowerShell 7 prerequisite.
`rtk pwsh -NoProfile -File .loom/tools/verify-harness.ps1` passed exactly with `HARNESS_LINT_OK` and `json=15 markdown=31 prompts=6 decisions=21`.

A clean dependency materialization via `rtk pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` succeeded but warned that `@prisma/client` build scripts were ignored; subsequent exact checks produced: lint exit 0 with warnings, `pnpm exec prisma validate` command-not-found, typecheck 29 errors, and build failure at TypeScript due the ungenerated Prisma client.

Installed Next.js 16.3.3 local guidance is present at `node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/15-route-handlers.md` and related server/caching guides, so the Next-specific read prerequisite is discoverable once dependencies are installed.

The capability map preserves distinct product, UI/UX, visual art, game, conversational AI, conversation psychology, life design, privacy/safety, application architecture and data-integrity stances; the verdict is caused by executable contract gaps, not missing professional labels.
